purpose: Primary-source and clearly labeled market-source registry used to design the SEO, AEO, GEO, content-recommendation, crawler-control, measurement, and agent-runtime distribution capabilities of this suite.

freshness_policy.collection_or_access_policy: Verify on the day an automated collection or authenticated integration is proposed.

sources.title: Optimizing your website for generative AI features on Google Search
sources.design_effect: Treat foundational SEO, original people-first content, crawlability, and page experience as Google-specific prerequisites. Google explicitly says llms.txt neither helps nor harms Google Search visibility because Search ignores it; keep it optional for other consumers. Reject fixed chunking, special AI schema, synthetic mentions, and generic AI-only rewrites as mandatory Google requirements.

sources.title: The /llms.txt file
sources.design_effect: Support a concise Markdown publisher guide with H1, summary, H2 file lists, descriptions, and an Optional section. Treat it as an open community proposal whose processing is client-specific, not as robots policy or a universal visibility standard.

sources.title: AI features and your website
sources.design_effect: Keep AI Overviews and AI Mode as separate surfaces. Require an indexed, snippet-eligible page for Google AI-feature eligibility, while never promise serving. Model Googlebot search access and Google-Extended separately.

sources.title: Generative AI performance report (Search)
sources.design_effect: Add an optional first-party measurement adapter for eligible verified properties. Preserve its availability state because rollout and low-impression limits can make data unavailable. Do not merge its impressions with observed-answer metrics.

sources.title: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
sources.design_effect: Content briefs must prioritize demonstrated expertise, original information, satisfying intent, factual accuracy, and useful primary purpose rather than word-count, keyword-density, or automation targets.

sources.title: General structured data guidelines
sources.design_effect: Schema recommendations must match visible main content, remain technically accessible, and describe rich-result eligibility rather than a ranking or AI-visibility guarantee.

sources.title: Understand JavaScript SEO basics
sources.design_effect: Technical recommendations must distinguish raw HTML, rendered HTML, crawlable links, HTTP behavior, and JavaScript rendering evidence instead of making unsupported server-rendering absolutes.

sources.title: Understanding page experience in Google Search results
sources.design_effect: Never emit a universal site or page score. Treat Core Web Vitals and page-experience data as diagnostic inputs with explicit measured evidence and a user-experience rationale.

sources.title: Build and submit a sitemap
sources.design_effect: Validate canonical, absolute, indexable URLs and sitemap size constraints. State that sitemap submission is a signal and not a crawling or indexing guarantee.

sources.title: Localized versions of your pages
sources.design_effect: Hreflang auditing and generation must validate self-references, reciprocal mappings, locale-specific URLs, and canonical alignment using an explicit URL/locale map.

sources.title: Overview of crawling and indexing topics
sources.design_effect: Route crawl, index, canonical, JavaScript, metadata, and robots decisions to their own evidence-backed technical lane.

sources.title: Webmaster Guidelines
sources.design_effect: Treat clear, independently verifiable, entity-consistent content and visible-content-matching structured data as Bing/Microsoft guidance. Keep its grounding and citation claims scoped to Bing/Copilot; do not generalize them to other engines.

sources.title: Introducing AI Performance in Bing Webmaster Tools Public Preview
sources.design_effect: Add a separately labeled, optional Bing first-party citation input. Preserve preview and property-access limitations instead of treating it as universally available.

sources.title: Citation dashboard in AI Visibility
sources.design_effect: Model cited-page counts, share-of-authority definitions, grounding queries, and AI referral traffic as platform-reported metrics with vendor definitions intact. Require verified-domain provenance.

sources.title: Bot Activity
sources.design_effect: Keep bot requests distinct from retrieval, grounding, citations, referrals, and conversions. Never infer downstream visibility from a crawler hit.

sources.title: Publishers and Developers - FAQ
sources.design_effect: Separate OAI-SearchBot access from GPTBot training preferences. Treat ChatGPT referral tracking as a reported UTM convention, not a complete attribution system. Use accessibility as an agent-compatibility consideration, not a ranking claim.

sources.title: Does Anthropic crawl data from the web, and how can site owners block the crawler?
sources.design_effect: Separate ClaudeBot training, Claude-User user-directed fetches, and Claude-SearchBot search indexing. Require an explicit business decision per bot and verify current vendor documentation before changing robots or WAF rules.

sources.title: Create plugins
sources.design_effect: Package the shared SKILL.md folders at a Claude Code plugin root, declare a stable plugin namespace, document namespaced invocation, and keep sharing metadata separate from Codex-specific UI metadata. Do not add hooks, MCP servers, or other runtime components unless the package actually needs them.

sources.title: Submitting your plugin
sources.design_effect: Keep the repository public and submission-ready. Direct individual authors to the Console form rather than assuming a personal Claude.ai plan has organization submission access; make no promise of directory approval or listing timing.

sources.title: Perplexity Crawlers
sources.design_effect: Separate PerplexityBot search indexing from Perplexity-User user-directed fetches. Do not recommend WAF allowlisting without current official IP-range verification and an authorized security owner.

sources.title: RFC 9309: Robots Exclusion Protocol
sources.design_effect: Describe robots.txt as crawler access guidance rather than access authorization. Validate standard syntax separately from vendor-specific support and behavior.

sources.title: ARIA Authoring Practices Guide
sources.design_effect: Offer semantic HTML, accessible names, roles, states, and keyboard behavior as accessibility and agent-compatibility recommendations where an interactive flow is in scope. Do not recast them as universal SEO ranking factors.

sources.title: Quantifying Uncertainty in AI Visibility: A Statistical Framework for Generative Search Measurement
sources.design_effect: Make repeated observations and confidence intervals opt-in but first-class. Treat single-run observations as samples, not fixed rankings or definitive citation shares.

sources.title: Don't Measure Once: Measuring Visibility in AI Search (GEO)
sources.design_effect: Require measurement plans to state sampling cadence, repeats, source of variance, and comparability rules before presenting trend or competition conclusions.

sources.title: AI Visibility Metrics
sources.design_effect: Adopt the useful product distinction between mention, citation, and optional retrieved-but-not-cited signals only when the surface exposes them. Do not import vendor weighting or volume proxies as suite truth.

sources.title: How to set up custom prompts to track brand visibility in AI assistants
sources.design_effect: Support an auditable blend of search-behavior-backed discovery and explicitly chosen custom prompts. Always preserve query provenance, locale, surface, cadence, and a frozen version of the corpus.

sources.title: How OtterlyAI collects data
sources.design_effect: Use this as evidence that leading products expose raw answer, citation, country, and per-engine details. Do not copy its browser-automation approach or bypass platform controls; our collection policy remains authorization- and terms-first.

sources.title: AI Visibility
sources.design_effect: Use prompt intent, competitors, sources, and action recommendations as product-pattern inputs, while retaining fully transparent definitions and no placement claims.

sources.title: Understanding the Citations Tab in Scrunch
sources.design_effect: Use page- and domain-level cited-source analysis as an actionable content-gap input, but preserve raw cited URLs, canonicalization rules, and engine-specific contexts.

sources.title: Query data in Search Console
sources.design_effect: The SEO performance contract records anonymized-query omissions, export truncation, and canonical URL aggregation instead of treating visible query rows as complete demand.

sources.title: Analyze your traffic with query filters
sources.design_effect: Support exact-query, regex-family, branded/non-branded, and query-to-page analysis while preserving property and export limitations.

sources.title: Make your links crawlable
sources.design_effect: Add a captured site-graph lane for crawlable navigation and contextual links without inventing a universal link count or depth threshold.

sources.title: Google Search documentation updates
sources.design_effect: Maintain current, preview, deprecated, and removed feature states; retain the May 2026 FAQ rich-result removal and revalidate changed merchant properties.

sources.title: Product structured data
sources.design_effect: Audit visible product pages, Product or merchant listing data, and Merchant Center feeds together while treating eligibility and acceptance as separate evidence.

sources.title: Help Google understand your ecommerce site structure
sources.design_effect: Connect crawlable product navigation, sitemaps, feeds, variants, and site-graph evidence instead of assuming a feed replaces discoverable pages.

sources.title: LocalBusiness structured data
sources.design_effect: Add a local lane that reconciles authorized business facts, location pages, profiles, and LocalBusiness data without promising map placement.

sources.title: Video structured data
sources.design_effect: Add a video lane for watch pages, VideoObject, player availability, thumbnails, livestreams, and Key Moments with visible-content parity.

sources.title: Video sitemaps and alternatives
sources.design_effect: Validate video sitemap discovery and update state while keeping video indexing and result eligibility separate from submission.

sources.title: Create a Google News sitemap
sources.design_effect: Add a publisher lane for article transparency, dates, corrections, media, news sitemap freshness, and policy evidence without inclusion promises.

sources.title: Designing websites for AI agents
sources.design_effect: Audit screenshot, DOM, accessibility tree, semantic controls, state, and safe task completion as agent readiness rather than ranking leverage.

sources.title: Universal Commerce Protocol specification overview
sources.design_effect: Treat UCP as an emerging optional capability with discovery, operations, authentication, owner, and fallback—not as an SEO or AI-visibility requirement.

sources.title: Web search tool
sources.design_effect: Visibility Run 2.0 separates user prompts, disclosed executed queries, all consulted sources, visible citations, user location, and live versus cached retrieval.

sources.title: Powering product discovery in ChatGPT
sources.design_effect: Add OpenAI product and merchant data to commerce parity/capability review without assuming a recommendation, checkout, or sales outcome.

sources.title: Web search tool
sources.design_effect: Preserve repeated searches, location, citation evidence, and multi-turn context when disclosed; do not generalize an API contract to every consumer surface.

sources.title: IndexNow protocol documentation
sources.design_effect: Add a bounded change-notification workflow for added, updated, and deleted URLs with key/endpoint verification, receipts, logs, and no indexing guarantee.

sources.title: Generative AI performance reports in Search Console
sources.design_effect: Track preview availability and supported dimensions as a feature lifecycle entry; do not assume a query dimension or universal property access.

sources.title: Generative Search Engine Optimization: A Cross-Engine Study
sources.design_effect: Keep retrieval, source selection, synthesis, and stability as separate experimental measurement dimensions; do not turn cross-engine findings into universal platform rules.
